gemini.rationale: The transaction is a corporate reorganization converting a master limited partnership into a Delaware corporation (T3 swap). The business model, product, processes, and organization (management and employees) all transferred intact (1-1) with continuity of ownership (T1 continue). There is no evidence of structural gaps between product and process (gap_45=0) or process and organization (gap_56=0).

grok.rationale: The slice states the reorganization was 'a change in corporate form of the same operating partnership rather than a transfer of assets to a different operator,' with no sourced fact that the customer-facing product (oil/NGL/gas) or its producing processes were separated or realigned independently of the legal-vehicle conversion; thus gap_45=0. Existing management was expected to 'stay in place' and unvested equity awards converted rather than being severed, so processes and organization remained aligned at closing and gap_56=0.

openai.rationale: The filing frames the reorganization as a change in corporate form of the same operating partnership and reports no separation or independent realignment of the oil-and-gas products and the processes that produce and deliver them, supporting gap_45=0. The existing management team was expected to remain in place, while employees’ and executives’ unvested awards converted automatically rather than being severed, supporting gap_56=0.
